subject: The 2AM idea that became your app
preview_text: You're not just using PupShape — you helped shape it. See what's next.
body_paragraphs: Two years ago, at 2AM, I sat on my kitchen floor, watching my bulldog, Gus, struggle to stand up after a long nap. I had just paid a $600 vet bill for his arthritis, linked directly to his weight. That moment broke something in me. I knew I wasn't the only one.

That night, I built the first crude prototype of PupShape. It was a mess — just a spreadsheet and a dream. But you downloaded it. You used it. And now, 110 dogs later, with an average 15% weight loss in 8 weeks, you're part of a movement. You're not a user; you're a founding member of a pack that's changing how we care for our best friends.

Right now, I'm working on a feature that I want your input on: a 'Legacy Mode' that lets you set long-term health milestones for your dog — like running a mile together by next summer. It's built for owners like you, who are in it for the long haul. Open the app and check your dog's progress dashboard — I added a beta preview of this feature just for you.
Tap 'Open PupShape' and see the new 'Legacy Milestones' section. It's waiting for you in the progress tracker. P.S. — Gus just hit his 20% weight loss goal. Your dog's story is next.
